# ADF JSON schema

`full.json` is the ADF JSON schema (draft-04) published by Atlassian in the npm package
[`@atlaskit/adf-schema`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@atlaskit/adf-schema), version 57.7.8,
file `dist/json-schema/v1/full.json`. It is licensed under the Apache License 2.0 and is
used unchanged, only by the tests, to check that every document this library produces is valid.
